notes: One logical two-leg monthly gold/silver centered-CUSUM reversion package. Q02 evaluates combined package PnL, paired costs, activity, and later Q09 correlation; neither component leg is a standalone strategy.

The EA selects thirteen synchronized completed month-end gold-minus-silver log ratios, forms twelve relative returns, centers them by their full-sample mean, requires one unique maximum absolute nonterminal cumulative deviation with split 4..8, and fades the post-split relative-return mean.

The package targets equal absolute USD notionals, caps aggregate frozen-stop risk at one RISK_FIXED budget, and follows the validated QM5_12533 logical-basket host-symbol recipe with USD tester currency and the canonical 100000 deposit.
